assessments.install_time_execution: The hashed workflow invokes the tooling-install helper before mapping any Vercel production token. The helper performs npm ci with lifecycle scripts enabled, rejects Vercel token variables, gives the npm child a reduced allowlisted environment and a temporary HOME, and withholds GH_TOKEN, VERCEL_TOKEN, GITHUB_ENV, and GITHUB_PATH from that npm child. This reduces direct credential and command-file access during this install. It is not a sandbox: it shares the GitHub job runner and checkout with the later operation, so node_modules/workspace mutation or a same-user background process persisting until credentials appear remains UNKNOWN_EXPOSED. Earlier pnpm, browser npm, and Playwright install steps also execute in this same job before Vercel credentials.
assessments.startup_import_execution: The .bin entrypoint resolves to dist/vc.js and the CLI bundle dist/index.js statically loads a broad command registry and chunk set. Startup/import evaluation is separate from selecting deploy --prebuilt; no complete module/call trace proves that every advisory-bearing package is excluded. UNKNOWN_EXPOSED.
assessments.fixed_deploy_command: The fixed prefix is deploy --prebuilt --prod --skip-domain --yes followed by seven --meta pairs for githubDeployment, githubCommitRef, githubCommitOrg, githubCommitRepo, githubCommitSha, githubOrg, and githubRepo. The artifact is prebuilt, stage creation skips automatic domain assignment, and promotion is separate. Official Vercel docs say --prebuilt deploys .vercel/output and --skip-domain avoids automatic domain assignment; those behaviors narrow build/domain activity but do not constrain CLI imports, parsers, or C1 token verbs. UNKNOWN_EXPOSED.
assessments.local_artifact_and_config_parsing: The helper creates a fresh temporary project, copies the verified .vercel/output and writes generated .vercel/project.json; it does not pass repository root config or --archive. The CLI still consumes local artifact/project metadata and response/config paths. Bundled js-yaml@3.13.1 and locked TOML/YAML/schema parsers exist; without full route tracing, not copying root YAML/TOML is not proof no affected parser can be reached. UNKNOWN_EXPOSED.
assessments.network_response_parsing: The credential-bearing Vercel CLI communicates with Vercel and parses API responses. Vulnerable undici copies, plus @fastify/busboy, are present in the locked graph; CLI also bundles a fetch-based API client. I cannot prove all reported undici or response parser sinks are reached by this exact endpoint set, or prove them unreachable. UNKNOWN_EXPOSED.
assessments.archive_extraction: The fixed prefix omits --archive and prebuilt deployment skips the application build step. The locked tree still contains @vercel/container -> tar, and the CLI has a broad command registry/dynamic routes not fully traced. No evidence proves every vulnerable tar parse/extract site unreachable. UNKNOWN_EXPOSED.
assessments.fallback_and_dynamic_paths: The operation sets VERCEL_CLI_USE_NATIVE_BINARY=0, NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1, isolated HOME, and prepends dirname(process.execPath) for the child. These reduce native/update and ambient-config fallback; the path resolves to the pinned JS entrypoint. They do not prove the absence of dynamic imports, subprocesses, package install modifications, fallback code, or runner persistence. UNKNOWN_EXPOSED.
assessments.credential_before_and_after_mapping: Vercel credentials are absent during this npm ci helper and not forwarded to lifecycle child processes. GitHub documents same-job steps execute on the same runner and can access the shared workspace; the workflow maps VERCEL_TOKEN later only in the operation step. Workspace mutation or surviving same-user process from install-time or earlier same-job dependency installation could act after token mapping. Child environment allowlisting limits inheritance, but does not isolate the process or token authority. GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_PATH are withheld from the npm child, but same-runner process/workspace attack paths are not ruled out. Before/after persistence is UNKNOWN_EXPOSED.
assessments.c1_blast_radius: The proposed C1 resource scope is one project only: team_NsBZHGUVnyygP7veiROKLuUx / kirari-main / prj_QNMVdxTkPOad4ynN4fwFCYEST8Jk. This reduces cross-project/account authority only if actual token scope is verified. The proposed Team Developer plus Full Production Deployment grants disclose same-project deployment, promotion, rollback, domain, project, and development/preview environment-variable capabilities. The token is not constrained to the fixed CLI flags; a compromised process could call APIs or exfiltrate it. Endpoint-level denial, actual principal/grants/expiry and owner approval remain UNKNOWN/pending.
